citation: Bukhari SMS, Zafar MH, Abou Houran M, Qadir Z, Moosavi SKR, Sanfilippo F. Enhancing cybersecurity in Edge IIoT networks: An asynchronous federated learning approach with a deep hybrid detection model. Internet of Things 27:101252, 2024. doi:10.1016/j.iot.2024.101252

A1.evidence: No train/test split method or percentages stated in Secs. 4-5; Sec. 5.2 only says testing used 'a substantial dataset of 443,700 instances'.

A2.evidence: Sec. 3.5: 'LSTM unit, which excels in processing sequential data'; no window, sequence length or input shape given (Secs. 3-5, Table 2), and split not described.

A3.evidence: Sec. 4 only: '1176 features, distilled down to 61 high-correlation features'; no scaling/encoding or fit scope stated in Secs. 3-5.

A4.evidence: Table 2 lists architecture/optimizer only; Sec. 3.4 gives lr decay 'η(t) = η0/(1 + δt)' without values; Sec. 5.2.4 'By round 20, the model achieves near-optimal performance' (no total rounds, no local epochs).

A5.evidence: CNN, isolated LSTM and Shallow ANN compared via ROC curves (Sec. 5.2.3, Figs. 12-15); no statement of their training rounds/epochs or whether they were federated.

A6.evidence: Sec. 5.2.3: ROC curves on the Edge-IIoTset for 'CNN Model' (Fig. 12), 'Isolated LSTM' (Fig. 13), 'Shallow ANN' (Fig. 15), i.e. produced by the authors; no numbers quoted from other papers.

A7.evidence: Sec. 5.1, Eqs. 16-20: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score; plus ROC-AUC (Sec. 5.2.3). No MCC/balanced accuracy/G-mean.

A8.evidence: Sec. 5: 'The dataset was distributed among ten different clients, mimicking a realistic IIoT network scenario'; partition scheme not described.

A9.evidence: Single values reported (e.g. precision/recall/F1 of 1.00, Table 4); no repeated runs, SD, CI or tests in Secs. 5.1-5.2.4.

A11.evidence: No code link in the visible text (Secs. 1-5.2.4).
